example.name: analyze_architecture
example.scenario: Analyze the cliff-watch architecture for principle violations
example.user_request: Analyze the cliff-watch architecture and identify DRY, SOLID, LEAN, and KISS violations

step.approach: Review the crates/ directory structure and module organization. Outcome: understand current architectural organization.
Search for duplicated patterns across modules. Outcome: list of architectural duplication.
step.analysis: Look for repeated communication patterns, validation logic, etc.

step.approach: Review modules for Single Responsibility violations. Outcome: list of modules with multiple responsibilities.
step.analysis: Check for tight coupling and dependency issues

step.approach: Look for unnecessary layers, abstractions, or complexity. Outcome: list of architectural waste.
step.analysis: Identify patterns that add no value

step.approach: Create comprehensive analysis document. Outcome: documented architecture review with recommendations.

example.completion: Architecture analysis complete with documented findings: - DRY violations: [list] - SOLID violations: [list] - LEAN waste: [list] - Recommendations: [list]

key_takeaways.takeaway: Document all architectural findings with clear rationale
Consider impact and effort for each recommendation

example.name: propose_module_refactoring
example.scenario: Propose refactoring to improve module boundaries
example.user_request: Propose a refactoring plan to improve module boundaries in cliff-watch-core

step.approach: Review cliff-watch-core module structure and dependencies. Outcome: understanding of current boundaries and coupling.
Look for modules with multiple responsibilities or high coupling. Outcome: list of boundary issues.
step.analysis: Identify modules that violate Single Responsibility

step.approach: Propose new module boundaries with clear responsibilities. Outcome: proposed architecture with improved boundaries.
step.analysis: Ensure new boundaries follow SOLID principles

step.approach: Create detailed refactoring plan with steps and rationale. Outcome: actionable refactoring plan.
Create Architecture Decision Record for the proposed changes. Outcome: documented decision with context and consequences.

example.completion: Module refactoring plan proposed: - Current issues: [list] - Proposed boundaries: [diagram] - Refactoring steps: [list] - ADR created: [file]

key_takeaways.takeaway: Create ADRs for significant architectural decisions
Propose incremental changes that can be validated
Document the rationale for each proposed change

example.name: design_new_component
example.scenario: Design a new component following principles
example.user_request: Design a new metrics collection component for the cliff-watch architecture

step.approach: Review requirements and existing architecture. Outcome: understanding of where new component fits.
Define clear interface and responsibilities. Outcome: component interface with single responsibility.
Define how component integrates with existing architecture. Outcome: integration design with clear boundaries.
step.analysis: Ensure minimal coupling to existing components

document.approach: Create comprehensive design document. Outcome: documented component design.

step.approach: Create Architecture Decision Record for the new component. Outcome: documented decision with context and consequences.

example.completion: New component design complete: - Interface: [specification] - Integration: [design] - Documentation: [file] - ADR: [file]

key_takeaways.takeaway: Design components with clear, single responsibilities
Document all design decisions with ADRs
